title: Termination Shock
author: Stephenson, Neal
review: Weirdly put together book that doesn't really work. Stephenson is usually a balance of quirkiness and big ideas but this way more on the side of overly quirky and a bit goofy and too light on the ideas.

highlights.text: The United States—which used to intervene in such situations—was a basket case and global laughingstock;
